review_candidates.title: Staff Software Engineer - Traffic
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Design and maintain scalable ingress/egress infrastructure, including API gateways, service mesh, CDN/edge compute, mTLS, and DNS, expressed as tested, reviewed code rather than hand-managed configuration. Partner with Security and compliance-focused teams to translate control requirements into automated, enforceable implementations such as policy-as-code, identity-aware routing, and cryptographic standards. Serve as an escalation point during incidents, troubleshooting complex production issues
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Partner with Security and compliance-focused teams to translate control requirements into automated, enforceable implementations such as policy-as-code, identity-aware routing, and cryptographic standards. Expert-level proficiency in Go or TypeScript, with working proficiency in a second language, alongside strong fundamentals in data structures, concurrency, API design, and software design patterns. Hands-on experience with unit, integration, and contract testing; CI/CD pipelines; feature flags; and instrumenting services for observability. An AI-first development mindset with proficiency leveraging AI tools to accelerate the software development lifecycle. A systems thinker with exceptional communication skills who enjoys the complexity of distributed systems, can turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical direction, and collaborate across time zones.
